warnings: Dimensions are estimates. The text states that the encoder fits within the 11.5 mm × 22.5 mm motor cross section on three sides and extends 7 mm past the fourth side. That gives a board about 22.5 mm wide and about 11.5 + 7 = 18.5 mm long. The 1.6 mm thickness is the standard PCB thickness and is assumed. Header pads are on a stated 2.54 mm pitch. The 4 mm center hole is estimated visually and is not stated. The 1 mm pad hole size is assumed. Hole positions are approximate. The slotted corner mounting or solder holes are visible but are not modeled. The magnetic disc (about 8 mm diameter, 2.5 mm thick) and the header pins are separate parts and are not included in the bounds. The shaft is stated to protrude 5 mm beyond the back of the motor.
Dimensions are estimated from the description and bounds; none are verified.
The board is modeled as a plain rectangle. The real outline has a notched or rounded shape.
The corner solder slots are visible but omitted because their size and position are uncertain.
The magnetic disc and the male and female header pins are separate parts and are excluded.
The 4 mm center hole size and position are visual estimates.
The 1 mm pad hole diameter and positions are assumed.
Hole positions were shifted by +9.25 mm in Y to put the board bottom at Y=0. The board thickness runs along Z, as in the given bounds.
